symbols.name: binary value
symbols.meaning: The nonnegative integer value of a binary string, with the leftmost bit most significant.
symbols.quote: For a binary string $x$, $\mathrm{val}(x)$ denotes its nonnegative integer value, with the leftmost bit most significant.

symbols.name: recursion levels
symbols.meaning: The number of levels of recursion, a count.
symbols.quote:
After $
u$ levels of recursion, where $
u$ counts the levels, the normalized cost is about $(s/W)^
u = (m^
u)^{\log_m(s/W)}$ times the base cost.

relations.quote: The theorem disproves [The n log n optimality conjecture](n-log-n-conjecture.md) in this model, and each later step exists to establish its bound.
The theorem is stated in the [Fixed-tape machine model](fixed-tape-model.md): the alphabet and the number of tapes do not depend on the input.

The first step reduces multiplication to a [Radix-digit convolution](radix-digit-convolution.md) of short integer coefficients, obtained by splitting each input into radix digits, that is, blocks of consecutive bits.

relations.predicate: places coefficients on distinct axes by
relations.quote: The method places coefficients on distinct axes by a [Chinese-remainder map](chinese-remainder-map.md) that preserves convolution.
The theorem gets its power saving from the [Rank-saving recursion](rank-saving-recursion.md): a call splits into smaller calls, each working on a stream holding a fraction of the stored bits.
The method lays out the transforms by a [Transform layout](transform-layout.md), so that a butterfly layer can act on every transform round.
The method keeps permutations inside the [Transform identity with retained permutations](transform-identity.md), so the source and target coordinate permutations need not be executed as sorts.
The theorem chooses its axis lengths by [Prime source lengths](prime-source-lengths.md): distinct odd primes lying just below powers of two.

relations.predicate: turns the last cyclic coordinate into
relations.quote: The method turns the last cyclic coordinate into a polynomial by [Phase twist](phase-twist.md).
The method handles the remaining axes by [Convolution over the polynomial ring](polynomial-ring-convolution.md).
The machine adds selected bits by [Packed selected-bit addition](packed-bit-addition.md).

relations.predicate: recovers the coefficients by rounding through
relations.quote: The method recovers the coefficients by rounding through [Exact coefficient recovery](recovery-and-error.md), which shows that the error is below one half.
The algorithm ends with [Carry propagation](carry-propagation.md), which turns the recovered coefficients into the exact binary product.
For large $n$ the theorem is faster than [Schoolbook multiplication](schoolbook-multiplication.md), which takes quadratic time in the number of digits.
